weaponScopeReconciliation.notAlwaysObtainable: Ordinary retainable inventory includes event-exclusive or otherwise no-longer-obtainable items; it does not mean every weapon is currently obtainable.

stageIdMapping.method: Wiki independently describes three stages and their ATK ratios/healing distinction. Numeric IDs are matched from existing local source records by those differentiators; the Wiki pages themselves do not publish these item IDs.
